items.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022
items.q: it was really an eye-opener when Trump got elected

ctx.x: I hope not. They just — it’s like they don’t think and they’re so angry and their morals, they have no morals. They’ll do whatever it takes to get what they want. They’ll cheat, they’ll lie, they’ll steal. And it was really an eye-opener when Trump got elected because I had no idea that there were that many people that would vote for somebody like that. I mean I knew they existed but I had no idea of the number. And what’s happening with race I mean it’s hard to — I guess that’s a plus of the internet age and…

Yes it makes it all that much more valuable. And I’m — I’ve felt like I’ve been an optimist most of my life but it’s harder and harder to be one now. And I agree with everything you’ve said and it seems like technology has brought out the worst in many people, the best in some but the worst in a lot of people. And it’s okay to share all of it and try to convince others to be that way, because I can.
